answer: Sybil resistance arises because each identity posts bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities triggers an O(k^2) penalty: pairwise evidence compounds slashing across escrows instead of imposing a flat fee. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss makes a swarm economically untenable as k grows; crystal-clear proofs, vertex-linked attestations, and an atlas of stake history expose coordination.
